inicio.kicker: WebMCP Track · course 5 of 6 · the last one · 8 lessons
inicio.titulo: WebMCP in production: page, server, test battery, and report
inicio.lead: Serve the same action through the screen, through WebMCP on the page, and through an MCP server, with a single rule. Log every call, freeze the test battery, watch the spec, and turn off a tool without a deploy. WebMCP is a draft as of 10/16/2026: production here means preparing with tests, not betting.
inicio.capa_alt: A small dark operations room with a monitor showing a browser and a rack with white lights, cables plugged into a hub.

numeros.t: test modes: no API, polyfill, native, and MCP server

inicio.aulas_sub: From the 8 layers to the report: three surfaces, log, frozen test battery, neighboring protocols, spec watcher, and governance.

itens: People who took course 2 (WebMCP on the page) and course 4 (security), or who already register tools and run an MCP server.
A dev or technical owner who will maintain a site used by agents for months, with the API still changing.
People who want to prove with a test, not a screenshot, that the site works with and without an agent.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: Serve one action through the screen, through WebMCP, and through MCP with the same rule.
Log calls, errors, refusals, and cancellations without storing personal data.
Freeze the test battery and catch the regression when the spec or the code changes.
Approve, version, and turn off tools through the catalog, without a code deploy.

blocos.t: Where this course fits in the WebMCP Track
itens: This is course 5, the last one: it brings together the page (course 2), the server (course 1), the agent's view (course 3), and security (course 4).
Each topic that belongs to another course is linked; here the focus is operations.
Before you start: Node 20 or newer, git, and disk space for Playwright's Chromium.

cursos.sub: This is course 5, the last one. Lesson 8 brings together the pieces from all six. Suggested order: 0 → 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5.

itens.t: Foundation: how agents use a site
itens.l: Read, operate the screen, or call a tool; accessibility tree; stable vs. draft; a diagnosis of your site.

itens.t: An MCP server for your service
itens.l: Official SDK v2 on the 2026-07-28 revision: tools, stateless Streamable HTTP, MRTR, OAuth, and MCP Apps.
document.modelContext with detection and fallback, lifecycle, annotations, confirmation, and the test battery in all three modes.
Test your site the way the agent sees it: Playwright MCP, Chrome DevTools MCP, and your site's task battery.
Prompt injection, data as data, confirmation, exposure, a secure server, and the identity of who arrives.
Three surfaces, the log, the frozen battery, the spec watch, governance, and your site's report.
